title: The Stage a Stopped Retrofit Project Is Charged At
content:
# The Stage a Stopped Retrofit Project Is Charged At

Which of the three cancellation fees of Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is taken on a stopped project is read from the dates the project record carries, and not from what the owner says the crew had or had not done.

## Rule

Where the project record carries the day the crew mobilised, the stage fee is taken at the project's cancellation fee for a project stopped after mobilisation.

Where the project record carries the day the equipment order was released to the supplier and no day the crew mobilised, the stage fee is taken at the project's cancellation fee for a project stopped after the equipment was released.

Where the project record carries neither of those days, the stage fee is taken at the project's cancellation fee for a project stopped after award and before the equipment order was released.

## Condition table

| Day the crew mobilised on the record | Day the equipment order was released on the record | Cancellation fee taken |
|---|---|---|
| carried | carried | the fee for a project stopped after mobilisation |
| carried | not carried | the fee for a project stopped after mobilisation |
| not carried | carried | the fee for a project stopped after the equipment was released |
| not carried | not carried | the fee for a project stopped after award and before the equipment order was released |

The mobilisation day governs wherever it stands on the record: a project that has mobilised has necessarily passed the earlier stages, so the release day makes no difference once a mobilisation day is carried.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A project record carrying an equipment release day of the 2nd and a mobilisation day of the 19th: the fee for a project stopped after mobilisation.
- A project record carrying an equipment release day of the 2nd and no mobilisation day: the fee for a project stopped after the equipment was released, whatever the crew is said to have done on site.
- A project awarded last week with neither day recorded: the fee for a project stopped after award and before the equipment order was released.
